overviewHtml:
Maintaining dashboards by hand across environments is error-prone and hard to repeat. These samples show how to deploy dashboards as code with Monaco, so the same views can be rolled out repeatably to any environment you manage.

What you get

  • Sample dashboards for monitoring and visualizing your environment
  • An executive dashboard
  • An SLI dashboard for service level indicators
  • A Monaco project with manifest and config, ready to deploy
prereqsHtml:
• Monaco >v2.15.0
  • Dynatrace Platform environment with Dashboards installed.
  • OAuth client as described here, including the additional scope: document:documents:write, document:documents:read, document:documents:delete, document:trash.documents:delete. This returns value for the environment variables CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET mentioned below.
getStartedHtml:
You need Monaco and an OAuth client with document scopes.

  1. Set the client ID and secret variables
  2. Deploy the project with Monaco

Full setup instructions are in the README.
